sonnet.problem: The card says 'Jeremiah himself speaks to the LORD' for Jeremiah 16:19. The BSB text doesn't name the speaker of the 'O LORD, my strength…' line, so the card is guessing who is speaking. A plain lead-in is needed.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.
